data: {"generalSituation":"Tropical Cyclone Noul will continue to move inland and dissipate gradually today. Meanwhile, an active southwesterly airstream will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, the weather will be unsettled over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. Showers will be heavier at times with squally thunderstorms over the region.
